menus.note:
NOTE (s): 
* 絵コンテ・演出 (Storyboard / Episode Director) is credited as just 演出 (Episode Director) in the credits. For my sanity I will just credit it as 絵コンテ・演出. 
* On that note, whenever the Storyboard role is split, it's never explicitly credited, but instead is merged into the Episode Director credit. I heavily disagree with that approach so I'll just include the Storyboard credit anyways.

The only credits missing are the staff for the OP and ED's since they're not known.
